name: gwp-bots
description: GWP — Ghost Wick Protocol. Three sub-bots (Crypto / Forex / Stocks) built from MVS-bot's shared-core architecture. M15 / M30 (trigger) / H1 / H2 (structure) / H3 / H4 (bias), 3-of-6 timeframe vote, POC+VAH+VAL+Fibonacci, zero lagging indicators. Scans every 15 minutes.

scripts.test: npm run test:live && npm run test:backtest && npm run test:units
scripts.test:units: node tests/test-resample.js && node tests/test-no-lookahead.js && node tests/test-cache-closed-only.js && node tests/test-groups.js && node tests/test-kucoin-seed.js
